nodes.label: Energy Function (computeU/ΔU/gateProposal)
nodes.triggeredBy: import — live gate core (energy-tick), breaker, cortex, trace, control-server, sims; CLI --worked-example
nodes.description: The scalar Lyapunov potential U, its gradient ΔU, and the accept/reject gateProposal — with a hard-veto (protected-path eta=100) plus a structural floor (ladder-inversion). This is the heart of the work-dynamics math and the live runtime gate core, fed real tool transitions by the energy-tick PostToolUse path; it reads a frozen 11-term DEFAULT_WEIGHTS and writes nothing.

nodes.label: Math Kernel (22 certified primitives)
nodes.description: The proven primitive library — 22 certified primitives (entropy, KL, cross-entropy, infoGain, confidenceDecay, brier, logLoss, bayes, softmax, dijkstra, A*, topo-sort, vector ops) with byte-stable rounding and sha256 result hashing. The foundational math layer the energy function and proof gate build on; stateless.

nodes.label: Energy Tick Core (tool-event→ΔU)
nodes.description: Turns LIVE session tool-events into real before/after control-plane state pairs and ΔU — salience tiering (SKIP/WORK/CRITICAL), per-transition state application, and a Layer-C depth-gated surprise trigger. Imported by the energy-tick PostToolUse hook; reads energy-weights via loadEnergyConfig and emits the trace each gated transition.

nodes.label: energy-tick hook (PostToolUse PDP)
nodes.description: The PostToolUse Policy-Decision-Point and everyday ΔU source — reads the session snapshot, runs tickAndTrace on each genuine tool transition, advances the circuit-breaker, and persists the snapshot. Async hook at settings.json L259, gated on YURI_ENERGY_OBSERVABILITY=1.

nodes.label: Energy Breaker (circuit breaker)
nodes.description: A Resilience4j-style CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN circuit breaker ported to the gate — catastrophic non-offsettable verdicts (protected-path / structural-floor veto) trip it, and it auto-decays so it can never permanently block. Splits the outcome-driven transition (PostToolUse) from the time-driven enforcement read (PreToolUse), reading its breaker blob from the energy-session snapshot.

nodes.label: energy-enforce hook (PreToolUse PEP)
nodes.triggeredBy: PreToolUse hook (settings.json L206), gated OBS=1 AND (ENFORCE=1 OR flag file)
nodes.description: The PreToolUse Policy-Enforcement-Point that finally makes the gate ACT — reads the trailing breaker state and DENIES the next tool call on a catastrophic OPEN verdict, registered LAST in PreToolUse and failing OPEN on any data gap. Gated on OBSERVABILITY=1 AND (ENFORCE=1 OR the energy-enforce.enabled flag file); shipped default is OFF.

nodes.label: Energy Config Loader (knob bridge)
nodes.triggeredBy: import — loadEnergyConfig per gated transition; CLI dump
nodes.description: The fail-closed config loader that validates the optional override (bad/non-finite values dropped, not coerced) and returns {weights, threshold, salience, evict, fsrs, recall} merged over in-code defaults. Called by tickAndTrace on every gated transition; the single externalized knob bridge between the energy-weights file and the gate.

nodes.label: Energy Weights Config Surface
nodes.description: The single externalized knob surface (_SYSTEM/SELF/energy-weights.json) where every value equals the in-code default — editing it steers the live system, and the drift test enforces that defaults-equality invariant. Read by config-loader/evict/relocator/fsrs/recall/brain-inject; written only by the control-server POST /apply.

nodes.label: Energy Trace (telemetry + Privacy Gate)
nodes.triggeredBy: import — traceGateEvaluation on live tick + experiments
nodes.description: JSONL telemetry for every gate evaluation, carrying the mechanically-enforced Layer-7 Privacy Gate (structural full-path allow-list, plain-object-only, toJSON/function/symbol/BigInt rejection, serialize-then-re-validate canary) and the closed-set canonical promotion-label key guard. Writes one record per gated transition to energy-trace/<date>.jsonl.

nodes.label: Claim-Evidence Cortex (epistemic sensor, UNWIRED)
nodes.triggeredBy: import / CLI --worked-example only — NO live hook consumer
nodes.description: The intended-but-UNWIRED live epistemic sensor — an in-session claim ledger, claimed-vs-evidenced ladder rank, FSRS-style evidence aging, and prior→posterior belief shift that emits a computeU-shaped snapshot lighting the 4 starved terms (alpha/beta/epsilon/zeta) plus the theta floor. Built (36KB) but NOT wired to any live hook; only its own --worked-example CLI / test exercises it, so the live tick still uses 5 of 11 terms.

nodes.label: Claim-Integrity Gate (canonical ladder)
nodes.description: Lints claim PROSE for over-claim vocabulary and owns the canonical PROMOTION_STATES ladder (draft→research→fixture_ready→runtime_tested→operator_validated→trusted→deprecated) that the cortex and trace single-source. Import (ladder) plus an on-demand CLI lint.

nodes.label: Math Proof Gate + Formula Banks
nodes.triggeredBy: on-demand CLI + tests; not a runtime hook
nodes.description: Binds each formula-bank card to a real math-kernel primitive and runs worked examples plus counterexamples (strict error-pattern match) before a bank can be promoted to non-advisory. On-demand CLI and tests only — not a runtime hook; reads the formula-bank JSON banks.

nodes.label: FSRS-4.5 Retention Scorer
nodes.description: The FSRS-4.5 retention scorer — power-law retrievability R(t)=(1+factor·t/S)^decay with R(S)=0.9, an effective-stability boost from salience/frequency/|ΔU|, demote/force-keep, and recall-bump. A shared math primitive: it reads fsrs:{} via its caller and is consumed by both the energy layer and the subconscious memory relocator (it does NOT import yuri-energy).

nodes.label: Energy Dispatch Bridge (LEGACY ΔU surface)
nodes.description: The ΔU surface that wires the dispatch paths (llm-lane, shintai-dispatch) into a synthetic ΔU=0 (or action-mode real-ΔU) trace, default-off and error-isolated. Still fires via traceDispatchEvent if those surfaces run, but the live everyday ΔU now flows through the energy-tick PostToolUse hook, not here.

nodes.label: Energy Sanitizer (raw→experiment bridge)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by experiment tooling; in-memory only
nodes.description: The only sanctioned raw-_SYSTEM/state → experiment bridge — an allow-list projection re-validated through the Privacy Gate, in-memory only. Imported by experiment tooling to safely lift recorded state into experiment scenarios.

nodes.label: Energy Simulate (gate grader)
nodes.description: The gate grader — runs the real gate against labelled adversarial+healthy scenarios and scores falseAccept / falseReject. Invoked on-demand via CLI and by the supercharge-gate.

nodes.label: Energy Experiment Runner
nodes.description: The scenario runner — pushes scenario modules (including experiments/descent-demo.mjs) through computeU/ΔU/gateProposal and records Privacy-Gate-validated traces. On-demand CLI (run --scenario); writes both an experiment JSON and energy-trace JSONL.

nodes.label: Energy Dashboard Data Aggregator
nodes.description: Assembles the read-only research-paper dashboard's real-data object with real/simulated/planned provenance tags. On-demand CLI / dashboard build; reads the energy-trace JSONL history and pulls legacy dispatch data via the bridge.

nodes.label: Energy Control Server (tuning cockpit backend)
nodes.description: The on-demand HTTP backend for the live tuning cockpit — previews 3 scenarios through the real gate, validates dials fail-closed, and (DEV-gated) writes tuned dials to energy-weights.json plus a changelog. An on-demand CLI launch, NOT a daemon.

nodes.label: Energy Observability Health Probe
nodes.description: The energy observability liveness probe for yuri-health — confirms the PostToolUse hook is registered in settings.json and that trace records accrue (absence is reported, not failed). Imported/CLI from yuri-health.

nodes.label: Action-Mode Study Harness
nodes.description: The study harness that runs the REAL gate in enforce semantics over labelled transitions (a confusion matrix is the gate's teeth-proof) and replays recorded traces for the real-traffic false-positive rate that gates graduation to enforcement. On-demand CLI; never blocks a live tool.

nodes.label: Energy Weights Drift Test (config↔code invariant)
nodes.description: Converts the _doc.values_are_defaults prose promise into an ENFORCED invariant — asserts every config value equals the in-code default across the energy/config/tick/fsrs surfaces. Run under node --test in CI and the supercharge-gate; reads energy-weights.json.

nodes.label: claude-memory-write (Track-B writer + reindex)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI add|remove|read|list|reindex; SessionStart hook runs reindex
nodes.description: The optional mediated write/CRUD path into Claude Track-B auto-memory: validates v3 frontmatter, enforces memory/-root containment + forbidden-segment refusal, and keeps MEMORY.md consistent. Native direct Write into memory/ is also allowed (block scoped to volatile subdirs 2026-06-02) so this wrapper is the optional validation/reindex helper, not a required gate.

nodes.label: yuri-recall (subconscious cue-recall, prior-turn-lag)
nodes.triggeredBy: UserPromptSubmit hook spawns detached every turn; CLI
nodes.description: The subconscious cue-recall organ: BM25 cue-match over the cold store + 1-hop spreading-activation across crosslinks + recency/salience blend yields a bounded top-K of advisory candidates, and surfacing bumps the usage ledger (testing-effect reactivation). Fired DETACHED every turn by the UserPromptSubmit hook with one-turn lag; never auto-writes memory and currently surfaces nothing because the cold store holds 0 rows.

nodes.label: memory-cold-store (the subconscious / cold FTS5 DB)
nodes.triggeredBy: library import — recall(query), relocator(upsert/get/remove), consolidator(get); CLI count|query
nodes.description: The embedding-free FTS5 long-term store that demoted memories relocate INTO (never deleted) — a SEPARATE DB (memory-cold.db) from the search corpus so the Memory/Search wall holds, with two tables cold_docs (FTS5 porter+unicode61) + cold_meta (salience/base-stability/crosslinks/demotedAt). Has its own inlined buildMatch decoupled from yuri-search; verified holding 0 rows (schema live, empty by design until demotion executes).

nodes.label: memory-usage (recall-event ledger — real USE signal)
nodes.triggeredBy: library import — recordUse per recall, buildUsageIndex; CLI record|index
nodes.description: The append-only replayable recall/reinforce ledger that REPLACES the broken atime-LRU signal — it replays into a usage index (useCount/lastUsed/lastReinforced) that the relocator scores retrievability off, not mtime/atime. Best-effort writes that never throw into the hot recall path; the jsonl is lazy-created on first recall and lives in writable _SYSTEM/state/.

nodes.label: memory-relocator (canonical forgetting — RELOCATE not delete)
nodes.triggeredBy: import via consolidator runSubconsciousPass; CLI (DRY-RUN unless --execute)
nodes.description: The canonical forgetting mechanism — FSRS-scored DEMOTION not deletion: a memory below the retrievability floor is copied verbatim into the cold store AND its source moved into reversible relocated/ (double safety), with a tombstone left in relocation-index.json; promoteHot() restores byte-identical. Tier sets base stability (semantic 60d / episodic 14d / working 3d); pinned + PROTECTED_TYPES (feedback, user) are exempt; DRY-RUN unless --execute (verified never executed).

nodes.label: kagami-memory-consolidator (subconscious orchestrator + daily MLX review)
nodes.description: The daily subconscious orchestrator running two jobs in one launchd organ: (1) L6 consolidation via runSubconsciousPass (FSRS demote-plan + executeRelocation + cold re-promotion proposals for slugs with useCount≥3) and (2) a Qwen3.5-4B MLX review of Track-B files for stale/dup/contradiction into memory-health.json. DRY-RUN unless --execute (no plist sets the flag), and the scoring half runs even when MLX is down.

nodes.label: memory-kernel (Track-A mediator: propose→decide→ledger)
nodes.description: The governed Track-A canonical mediator (propose→decide→ledger) for operating truth shared across all lanes — RBAC by lane, proposeMemoryWrite / recordMemoryProposalDecision / promoteMemoryProposal→appendLedger over a dual-ledger, plus recallEntries; emits Kagami events on promote and enforces protected surfaces via safeRuntimePath. Library import only, not auto-scheduled.

nodes.label: memory-proposal-autopilot (deterministic + Codex reviewer)
nodes.triggeredBy: invoked by yuri-autonomy-runner + operator CLI (no launchagent)
nodes.description: Polls the Track-A proposal queue and runs a DETERMINISTIC review first (reject protected-surface mutation intent via verb-aware unnegated-intent matching, reject empty/no-id, defer oversized, rewrite peer-lane blame), escalating only ambiguous cases to Codex/main. Optional scoped auto-commit stages ONLY a source/docs allowlist and runs secret-leak-scan BEFORE committing, refusing if allowlist paths were dirty pre-run.

nodes.label: secret-leak-scan (scoped-commit secret gate)
nodes.description: The secret gate the autopilot runs via spawnSync BEFORE any scoped commit — a non-zero exit aborts the commit. Verified to exist and be executable; reads the git staged diff as its input.

nodes.label: memory_governor.py (Track-A memory.db lifecycle governor)
nodes.description: The Track-A lifecycle governor over the large legacy memory.db (~230MB): STM/MTM/LTM split, importance scoring, daily/weekly/monthly consolidation cycles, quarantine, research-watch — a SEPARATE consolidation system from the FSRS cold-store subconscious (this governs the SQLite DB, the relocator governs the .md cold store). Its old session-boot RAG recall-injector role is SUPERSEDED by yuri-recall; lifecycle/health/SessionEnd-write role remains live.

nodes.label: memory-session-write (SessionEnd episodic capture)
nodes.description: The SessionEnd episodic-capture organ — reads the last sentinel learning-session observation and writes it as episodic Track-A memory through memory_governor.py, opportunistically triggering weekly consolidation if the last run is >7d old. Fired by the settings.json Stop/SessionEnd hook (L292).

nodes.label: memory-evict / memory-archive (SUPERSEDED legacy relics)
nodes.description: The two original crude forgetting paths now SUPERSEDED by memory-relocator: evict = atime-LRU over memory/patterns/*.md moving stale files to memory/patterns-archive/; archive = mtime+flag move with NO recall path. DORMANT — no live trigger (no launchagent/hook/spawn); the broken atime signal is the exact bug memory-usage.mjs was built to fix.

nodes.label: Corpus Search Engine (yuri-search)
nodes.description: On-demand FTS5/BM25 query engine over the ~38.7k-doc local corpus (live count 38,742; the in-file '~26k docs' comment is stale), returning path+snippet ranked by bm25 and never auto-injected. Exports the injection-hardened buildMatch() that quotes every term as an OR-of-quoted-terms so raw user input can never inject FTS5 operators.

nodes.label: Corpus Indexer (yuri-search-index)
nodes.description: The corpus indexer that builds/refreshes search-index.db — walks 8 corpus roots, incremental by mtime, Porter+unicode61 FTS5 with WAL, and prunes deleted files. Strictly manual (no SessionStart hook, no LaunchAgent, no cron); enforces the Memory/Search Wall via an EXCLUDE_SUBSTR list + isProtectedPath so it literally cannot index .env, .claude/state, or the memory DBs.

nodes.label: Context Router (symbolic trigger-scoring)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI — run before broad work (CLAUDE.md mandate); not a hook
nodes.description: The pre-broad-work context selector CLAUDE.md mandates — scores each registry packet by counting literal trigger substrings in the task text and returns the top context packet plus its read-order and protected paths. Pure substring-count (no embeddings) so it is fully auditable, but it uses process.cwd() as repo root and must run from repo root or registry resolution fails.

nodes.label: Track-A Warm Memory Recall (memory-kernel recallMemory)
nodes.description: Track-A recall over the WARM canonical store (_SYSTEM/memory/*.md|json|txt) — tokenizes the query, scores each file with a resolvable lexical-default scorer, and returns top-K with sha256 provenance. The warm/lexical tier of the two-tier retrieval split, distinct from the cold-store FTS5 recall (yuri-recall over memory-cold.db); do not conflate the two.

nodes.label: Evidence Contract Validator (yuri-evidence-contract)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI — gate a PASS claim on swarm artifact dir
nodes.description: Gates a swarm artifact dir's PASS claim by validating it contains the required deterministic grammar (TERM_COUNT / FILE_COUNT / MATCH), exiting 1 on a missing, invented, or empty verdict. Its three REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_PATTERNS regexes are the literal evidence grammar from yuri-origin.md.

nodes.label: Required-Evidence Resolver (evidence-contract)
nodes.description: Pure no-I/O function that maps a task string → required evidence-source IDs (Shintai base set, plus a memory/RAG set on regex match and a cyber set on security regex). Despite the near-identical name it is a different organ from the validator — it answers 'what evidence does this task require' (requiredEvidenceIdsForTask), called at import time by memory-kernel.

nodes.label: Research Capture + Provenance
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI — capture online findings, then manual `ai reindex`
nodes.description: Captures online research findings into the local compounding corpus — inits an archive dir, writes a manifest + source registry carrying provenance, and fetches sources, emitting a dated markdown file under 02_RESOURCES/research/. The capture→corpus bridge is NOT automatic: the written .md becomes searchable only after a manual ai reindex.

nodes.label: ai CLI Facade (retrieval front door)
nodes.description: The single bash dispatcher and true ingress of the retrieval layer — exec-style pure routing where 'ai search|find' → yuri-search, 'ai reindex|search-index' → yuri-search-index, and 'ai triage|research' → run_triage. Must be invoked as bash 'ai …', never 'node ai'.

nodes.label: Cross-Domain Transfer Engine (PHANTOM — claimed not built)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLAUDE.md claims problem-solving; NO executable trigger exists
nodes.description: PHANTOM node: CLAUDE.md claims a live 'cross-domain transfer engine (mechanism-tagged cross-reference over the FTS5 corpus)' for problem-solving, but grep finds zero implementing module — it exists only as the future-build YURI memory PROJ:CROSS-DOMAIN-TRANSFER-ENGINE. The corpus search (yuri-search) is real; the mechanism-tagged transfer layer on top of it is not, so this node carries no executable trigger and no files.

nodes.label: bash-security-guard (primary Bash deny gate)
nodes.description: The primary deterministic Bash deny gate (PreToolUse, 2nd in chain) — it DENIES .env read/write/mutate/remove, sensitive .claude file reads, broad .claude destruction/git-rm/git-add, download-execute curl|bash chains, mkfs, shell-wrapper inline-exec, and coworker push/remote/role-path mutation (with an intra-repo .env mirror exemption). It resolves the operator role to decide what a coworker-role session may run.

nodes.label: operator-write-guard (tool-agnostic trust-surface guard)
nodes.description: The tool-agnostic defense-in-depth write gate (PreToolUse, 3rd in chain) — denies coworker-role Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit onto the trust surface (dev-credential.json, yuri-operator.cjs, and every enforcement hook including itself), closing the gap that bash-security-guard only inspects Bash. Uses case-insensitive APFS + symlink-realpath ancestor-climb canonicalization and fails closed.

nodes.label: yuri-operator (two-role resolver + scrypt credential)
nodes.triggeredBy: require — resolveRole by the guards; fail-closed→coworker
nodes.description: The dev/coworker role trust root — verifies the owner passphrase in YURI_DEV_KEY via scrypt (N=16384,r=8,p=1, timingSafeEqual) against the on-disk credential. A broken module plus existing creds is treated as a tampering signal, not an error, and resolves fail-closed to the coworker role.

nodes.label: tirith-url-guard (URL threat assessment)
nodes.description: The URL threat-assessment gate (PreToolUse, Bash) — extracts URLs from a Bash command and scores each via the external ~/.hermes/bin/tirith binary, escalating MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL to permissionDecision='ask'. A missing binary silently allows unless TIRITH_FAIL_LOUD=1 is set.

nodes.label: claude-protocol-guard (routing/control-plane gate)
nodes.description: The routing/control-plane gate (PreToolUse, 5th in chain) — reads session-state.json for the plan_dispatch_gate and emits WARN advisories for missing-control-packet / missing-codex-task-spec / missing-route-plan-evidence / post-plan-dispatch-required, upgrading WARN→DENY on a critical-tier packet. It writes gate satisfaction/warn-count back to state; YURI_SPRINT_MODE=1 suppresses it.

nodes.label: yuri-risk-lite (catastrophe regex scanner)
nodes.triggeredBy: PreToolUse hook 8th in chain (Bash); also module for scout
nodes.description: The regex catastrophe scanner (PreToolUse, 8th in chain, Bash) — hard-DENIES the deny:true set (mkfs, raw /dev/sd* writes, DROP DATABASE) and surfaces everything else (rm -rf, force-push, DROP TABLE, curl|bash) as a visible advisory rather than a block. Also exported as a module consumed by the scout-orchestrator.

nodes.label: lane-kernel (protected-surface + control-file source)
nodes.description: The protected-surface + control-file source of truth — exports isProtectedPath / safeRuntimePath / CONTROL_FILE_PREFIXES that the protocol guard, memory-kernel, and the search indexer all single-source. It is the shared library that defines which paths are off-limits and which files are control-plane files.

nodes.label: brain-inject (unified boot brain composer)
nodes.triggeredBy: SessionStart hook (settings.json L112) — reads ~14 state files
nodes.description: The unified boot brain composer (.claude/hooks/brain-inject.js): on the SessionStart SYNC hook (settings.json L112) it reads ~14 sources and emits a single <yuri-brain> block joining a stable Zone-A core (identity/hardware/learned-rules/memory) with a volatile Zone-C footer (session/lane-health/gate/cortex/fingerprint/geass). It re-extracts the same 9 SOUL.md persona headings the native @-include already loaded, so live state rides in alongside the always-present stable identity.

nodes.label: soul-persona-inject (SubagentStart persona)
nodes.description: The SubagentStart persona hook (.claude/hooks/soul-persona-inject.js) that injects the SOUL persona contract into every spawned subagent's context. It fires on SubagentStart (settings.json L154), NOT SessionStart — the boot-time persona load moved into brain-inject's [identity] section, leaving this hook to cover only subagents.

nodes.label: Cortex Dynamic (cross-turn risk + PDC priors)
nodes.triggeredBy: read by brain-inject; written by pulse/risk surfaces
nodes.description: The cross-turn cognitive state file (.claude/state/cortex-state.json) holding accumulated risk and PDC (probabilistic-decision-core) priors. It is a read surface for brain-inject's volatile footer and is written by the pulse/risk surfaces, not by this layer.

nodes.label: Behavioral Fingerprint (L2/L3 self-model)
nodes.triggeredBy: read by brain-inject; written by sentinel self-model
nodes.description: The L2/L3 behavioral self-model file (.claude/yuri-sentinel/self-model/fingerprint.json) capturing the behavioral fingerprint and drives. Read by brain-inject into the volatile footer; written by the sentinel self-model subsystem.

nodes.label: persona.md / SOUL.md (native @-include identity)
nodes.triggeredBy: harness NATIVE @-include of CLAUDE.md — no hook fires
nodes.description: The native stable identity trio (_SYSTEM/persona.md, SOUL.md, _SYSTEM/yuri-origin.md) loaded by the harness's @-include of CLAUDE.md with NO hook firing. This is the always-present identity the whole Cognition & Persona layer rests on — if every SessionStart hook failed, this still loads.

nodes.label: Neuron-Loop (9-phase self-synthesis)
nodes.description: The 9-phase self-synthesis self-improvement loop driven by a real launchd agent (com.yuri-os-musubi.neuron-loop.plist, verified HEALTHY on disk, not 0-invocations); it runs autonomously and records its last run so the boot brain can ingest it. Its log is the NEURON_LOOP section brain-inject reads at SessionStart, closing the loop launchd → neuron-loop.mjs → log → brain.

nodes.label: Kagami Event Bus
nodes.triggeredBy: import — appendKagamiEvent on memory promote etc.
nodes.description: The append-only Kagami event log surface — its appendKagamiEvent(kind, payload) writes one validated JSON event per line (events.jsonl) on lifecycle moments like memory promotion, with a closed kind allow-list. It is the cross-organ event spine memory-kernel and other surfaces fire into to record durable system events.

nodes.label: Dream-Processor (mistakes→rules)
nodes.description: The Dream-Processor that runs at session Stop, mining the session's human messages and detected corrections into a learning prompt and queuing learned rules into the global/project learning ledgers. It is how repeated operator corrections graduate into durable lessons that apply to every agent.

nodes.label: Session-Reflect (mid+end reflection)
nodes.triggeredBy: Stop hook (L305) + spawned mid-session by pre-tool-use tier-4
nodes.description: The reflection organ that fires at session Stop and is also spawned mid-session (detached) by pre-tool-use at compaction tier 4; it writes dated newest-first entries into the Track-B session-journal.md and dedups the MEMORY.md Session-Notes block. It captures skills used, compact hints, and session shape into continuity memory.

nodes.label: yuri-health (lane/launch health monitor)
nodes.description: The lane/launch health monitor — a CLI/monitor harness that runs a roster of subprocess health probes (memory_governor health, energy-observability-health, skill-registry, launchd status, gitnexus) and emits a PASS/FAIL summary table. It is the single liveness dashboard that confirms the heavy memory and energy circuits are actually wired and accruing.

nodes.label: startup-offload (MISNOMER — skills indexer)
nodes.triggeredBy: SessionStart hook (L121) — emits <startup-index>, ZERO offload code
nodes.description: A misnamed SessionStart hook (settings.json L121, async) that despite its name carries ZERO offload/dispatch code — it is purely a skills-frontmatter indexer that scans .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md (name+description) and emits a <startup-index> 'Skills (N)' roster so the session knows the available skills without re-reading every SKILL.md. Grep for spawn/exec/runner/route/dispatch/llm returns nothing; it does NOT run the dispatch core (llm-lane).

nodes.label: llm-compat-contract (lane/scenario/lifecycle contract)
nodes.description: The single lane/scenario/lifecycle routing contract per yuri-origin.md — the one authoritative source of lane tables, model tables, and lifecycle matrices that adapters must not duplicate. Import-only library surface; no boot trigger of its own.

nodes.label: Scout Orchestrator (event-driven scout dispatch)
nodes.description: Event-driven scout dispatch hook wired across three lifecycle points: SessionStart inits the scout bus + trims errors, PreToolUse injects findings, PostToolUse spawns background scouts — dispatched by payload shape. Gated off via YURI_DISABLE_SCOUTS=1; reuses yuri-risk-lite as a risk-scan module and persists state to scout-bus.json.

nodes.label: shintai-dispatch (SEAL-team dispatch)
nodes.description: The SEAL-team (Shintai 神隊) dispatcher — assembles a task-sized roster (not a fixed team) and dispatches the lanes; when it runs it fires the legacy energy-dispatch-bridge (L1165) to emit a ΔU trace for the dispatch event. Import/CLI triggered, not auto-scheduled.

nodes.label: llm-lane (consolidated dispatch core — the single openai-compatible path)
nodes.description: The ENTIRE dispatch path for the 3 reasoning lanes (deepseek-v4-pro, nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, kimi-k2.6), all openai-compatible. Replaced the ~4040-line offload-runner/reasoning-lane-dispatch/*-dispatch-adapter stack in the 2026-06-05 consolidation. ~420 lines: prompt in -> text out, with a full-YURI-stack system loadout (brain/persona/origin/INDEX) and read_file/grep/list_dir/search/context_router/fetch_url/bash tools so the lane operates BY the framework, not blind. Fail-closed guards: endpoint host ALLOWLIST (api.deepseek.com / integrate.api.nvidia.com), fetch_url private/loopback/metadata DENY, protected-surface + git-mutation deny on bash. Advisory-until-verified, and wired into the YURI core like a native lane via lane-core-hooks: every dispatch fires energy ΔU (traceDispatchEvent), memory recall (injected as a recall block so the lane carries episodic memory), evidence (lane_output -> control-plane memory-ledger), and the docked-output symbiotic pulse (advisory-until-verified). A lane call is an input into YURI that triggers the same core machinery a native operator turn does — the orchestrating lane just supplies the input. This is the seam any future frontier model plugs into to inherit the full core.

nodes.label: lane-core-hooks (core-ingest for pluggable model lanes)
nodes.triggeredBy: import — called by llm-lane on every dispatch (coreOnDispatch) and result (coreOnResult)
nodes.description: The single core-ingest seam that makes ANY frontier model plugged into the lane fire the full YURI core from INSIDE the dispatch, like a native operator turn. coreOnDispatch: energy ΔU (traceDispatchEvent) + memory recall (yuri-recall over the cold store, returned as an injectable block so the lane carries episodic memory). coreOnResult: evidence (lane_output -> control-plane memory-ledger) + the mandatory docked-LLM-output symbiotic pulse (source=docked-llm, authority=advisory_only, verdict=verify -> lane-pulse-trace). Fully error-isolated — a core hook never breaks dispatch. THIS is where to extend when wiring more of the core (protocol, cortex).

nodes.label: token-session-init (boot token tracking + tokenmaxxing)
nodes.description: SessionStart hook (settings L108, sync) that boots token tracking: reads the git branch, writes the per-session and weekly token files plus session-state.json (guarded — skips the session-state write if an active root session is <4h old). Greps tokenmaxxing/SKILL.md '## Rules' and injects the '⚡ TOKENMAXXING ACTIVE' banner + those rules as additionalContext so token-efficiency mode is on by default.

nodes.label: pre-tool-use (token/compaction + cross-terminal)
nodes.description: The 6th PreToolUse hook: token/compaction + cross-terminal awareness. Reads session-state.json context.pct, the memory bus, and MEMORY.md, emits /compact hints on a 5-tier ladder, and at tier 4 spawns session-reflect --mid-session detached; on another terminal's bus write it injects a cross-terminal update. Writes compact_history, context.tier, and the bus cursor.

nodes.label: post-tool-use (main bookkeeper)
nodes.description: The 1st PostToolUse hook and the main session bookkeeper: writes session-state.json (tools_used, errors, files_written, skills_read/written), pushes to the memory bus on a memory-file write, appends design-memory on a design-file write, and arms plan_dispatch_gate on a successful ExitPlanMode so claude-protocol-guard reads it next turn.

nodes.label: token-tool-logger (per-tool estimate + ledger spawn)
nodes.description: PostToolUse hook (C) that estimates per-tool cost: reads /tmp/claude-current-session, pushes {tool,estimate,time} and increments estimatedTokens from a heuristic table (Agent 8000, Read 800, etc.), then spawns token-ledger.mjs write detached for the durable hashed record.

nodes.label: token-ledger (crypto-chained ledger)
nodes.description: The crypto-chained, privacy-hashed durable token ledger (SQLite token_ledger table with prev_hash/event_hash chaining and hashed payloads). Spawned detached by token-tool-logger to persist one tamper-evident estimate event per tool call.

nodes.label: token-budget-check (budget WARN/CRITICAL)
nodes.description: The 9th PreToolUse hook: a budget advisory that reads /tmp/claude-current-session estimatedTokens and emits a 🟠 WARN at ≥80k and a 🔴 CRITICAL at ≥150k (advisory only, never denies) nudging toward ai-search over raw reads and a fresh session.

nodes.label: session-state (canonical lifecycle file mediator)
nodes.triggeredBy: require — read/write by pre/post-tool, protocol-guard, checkpoint
nodes.description: The canonical lifecycle-file mediator (read/write surface for .claude/state/session-state.json) used via require, so hook subprocesses bypass the tool-level deny-list. Called by pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, claude-protocol-guard, musubi-protocol-enforce, session-checkpoint, and token-session-init.

nodes.label: memory-bus (cross-terminal awareness)
nodes.description: The cross-terminal session cursor backed by .claude/memory-bus.json: lets concurrent terminal sessions see each other's recent activity (e.g. memory-file writes) so one session can surface another's updates. Required by pre-tool-use and post-tool-use.

nodes.label: session-checkpoint (periodic snapshot)
nodes.description: PostToolUse hook (D) that writes an incremental session snapshot (.claude/state/session-checkpoint.json) roughly every 30+ minutes, reading the canonical session lifecycle state via the session-state mediator to build the snapshot.

nodes.label: pre-tool-gate (local-first advisory, async non-blocking)
nodes.triggeredBy: PreToolUse hook 1st (async — does NOT gate the chain)
nodes.description: Local-first advisory hook (.claude/hooks/pre-tool-gate.js): on a large Read or broad Bash it emits an additionalContext route-to-deepseek-flash advisory. Registered PreToolUse 1st but ASYNC, so despite its position it does NOT gate the chain (the deterministic guards are the real first line); always continue:true and writes nothing.

nodes.label: musubi-protocol-enforce (AEONIC soft compliance)
nodes.description: AEONIC soft-compliance hook (.claude/hooks/musubi-protocol-enforce.js), PreToolUse 7th and 60s-throttled: warns on >3 direct writes with 0 Agent dispatches, or an Agent dispatch carrying no skill. Records its last run time as aeonic.lastEnforceAt; advisory only, never blocks.

nodes.label: musubi-protocol-ingest (AEONIC boot ingest)
nodes.description: SessionStart boot hook (.claude/hooks/musubi-protocol-ingest.js, settings L116) that reads the legacy MUSUBI_PROTOCOL.md shim (872 bytes: CORE_DIRECTIVES / GLOBAL_LLM_COMPAT_DIRECTIVE / ROLE_MATRIX), stashes the parsed sections into state.aeonic.sections, and emits a <musubi-protocol> context block into the boot load.

nodes.label: user-prompt-submit (per-turn volatile re-inject)
nodes.description: Per-turn volatile re-inject hook (.claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.js, UserPromptSubmit, <50ms exit): consumes the prior council brain-stale.sentinel into <brain-update>, consumes the one-turn-lagged subconscious recall envelope while spawning THIS turn's detached recall, fires skill-auto-trigger + design-master context on matched verbs, and routes HANDOFF_TRIGGERS to EOT. Pulse-orchestrator, the PATCH-040 memory.db RAG, and the old governor RAG spawn are retired in code; never blocks.

nodes.label: eot-background-start (EOT monitor arm)
nodes.description: SessionStart boot hook (.claude/hooks/eot-background-start.js, settings L131) that arms the continuous-reflection EOT engine by writing the per-session /tmp/claude-eot-<sid>.marker and emitting 'EOT monitoring active'; the actual handoff-intent detection happens later, per-turn, inside user-prompt-submit.

nodes.label: agent-spawn-guard (OBSERVABILITY-ONLY since 2026-05-30)
nodes.triggeredBy: PreToolUse matcher=Agent — logs only, always allows
nodes.description: PreToolUse hook matched on Agent (.claude/hooks/agent-spawn-guard.js): OBSERVABILITY-ONLY since 2026-05-30 after its old hard-deny was removed — it logs subagent_type and model to stderr and always allows the spawn.

nodes.label: gitnexus-hook (graph-context enrich)
nodes.description: Global PreToolUse hook (~/.claude/hooks/gitnexus/gitnexus-hook.cjs) matched on Grep|Glob|Bash that enriches the call with GitNexus graph context under a 10ms timeout; advisory enrichment, not a gate.

nodes.label: artifact-registry (protected-path + repo-path norm)
nodes.description: Shared library module (_SYSTEM/Scripts/artifact-registry.mjs) exposing isProtectedPath / normalizeRepoPath / loadArtifactRegistry — the canonical protected-path test and repo-path normalizer imported by gates rather than fired as a hook.

nodes.label: yuri-user (current user handle attribution)
nodes.description: Shared library module (_SYSTEM/Scripts/yuri-user.mjs) exposing currentUserHandle, the single source of user attribution stamped onto energy traces and dispatch records.

nodes.label: nemotron lane (advisory external reasoning, via llm-lane)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI / llm-lane dispatch — advisory external reasoning lane (DEV-ONLY)
nodes.description: Advisory external reasoning lane (Nemotron-3-Ultra, nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) dispatched via the consolidated _SYSTEM/Scripts/llm-lane.mjs core — the single dispatch path for all 3 lanes (deepseek/kimi/nemotron); the standalone nemotron-dispatch.mjs adapter was retired 2026-06-05. DEV-ONLY; advisory-until-verified, returns evidence into the control plane — never a release gate.

nodes.label: propagation-scan (cross-reference engine V1)
nodes.description: Read-only cross-reference engine V1 (_SYSTEM/Scripts/propagation-scan.mjs): resolves a circuitry node-id and surfaces its structural mechanism-siblings via shared node.files membership and GitNexus structural relations (writes-edges excluded). Pure analyzer — reads the circuitry graph + GitNexus and writes nothing to either graph.

nodes.label: xref-query (unified retrieval surface)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI / import — unified retrieval front door feeding propagation-scan
nodes.description: Unified retrieval surface (_SYSTEM/Scripts/xref-query.mjs) over the corpus FTS5 index, the circuitry graph (1-hop graph-neighbors by edge.kind; writes edges excluded), and GitNexus — the single front door whose results feed the propagation-scan structural cross-reference.

nodes.label: Math Adapter Contract (external engine fence)
nodes.triggeredBy: import — validateMathAdapterManifest / validateMathLabManifest from health, tests, and lab-harness consumers
nodes.description: Fail-closed manifest validator for external math engines and lab adapters. It enforces the v0 schema, allowed run modes and promotion states, non-empty capabilities, and writesRuntimeTruth:false so polyglot engines stay declared, scoped, and non-runtime unless a separate owner-approved gate promotes them.

nodes.label: Math Health (archive/adapter/proof diagnostic)
nodes.description: Read-only health probe for the math substrate. It checks archive files and source counts, validates the lab adapter manifest, inspects formula banks through the proof gate, and runs smoke fixtures over core math primitives such as Dijkstra, A*, Brier, log-loss, Bayes, weighted mean, dot product, and softmax.

nodes.label: Mechanism Pattern Registry (closed propagation verbs)
nodes.triggeredBy: import / CLI — propagation-scan imports MECHANISM_PATTERN_VERBS; CLI validates _SYSTEM/data/math/mechanism-pattern-registry.json
nodes.description: Closed-set validator for the v0 mechanism-pattern verb taxonomy. It exports a read-only five-verb membership surface and validates registry schema, semver, promotion status, advisoryOnly, required verb fields, duplicate entries, >=2 witnesses, and path:line witness shape; validation rebuilds a private Set so importers cannot self-mint verbs.

nodes.label: Energy Trace Outcomes (deferred label join)
nodes.triggeredBy: import / CLI — resolveOutcome appends labels; readJoinedDecisions and CLI summarize decision→outcome joins
nodes.description: Pure-additive deferred-outcome layer for the energy decision trace. It builds Privacy-Gate-safe binary outcome records keyed by runId, appends them to a second JSONL stream, and left-joins decisions to the latest outcome per runId for replay while leaving unresolved rows visible.

nodes.label: Operational Math Simulation (synthetic advisory report)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI / import — node _SYSTEM/Scripts/math/math-operational-simulation.mjs or buildOperationalSimulationReport(); listed in _SYSTEM/labs/math/lab-manifest.json
nodes.description: Deterministic report generator over owned synthetic YURI workflows. It composes existing math-kernel primitives for memory ranking, context routing, RAG conflict detection, tool routing, release scoring, and creative scheduling, emits advisoryOnly/localTruthClaim:false/writesRuntimeTruth:false metadata, and hashes the stable JSON sections.

nodes.label: Transfer Distance (Mechanism-Bridged Transfer Surprise)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by transfer-distance-cores/proof/bakeoff/v2demo/tests; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Pure advisory scoring engine for cross-domain transfer triangles A→M→B: normalized compression distance plus Jaccard baseline distance, min-side mechanism reconstruction bridge, anti-theater caps, prerequisite-blocked detection, and value tiering. Exports MIN_CHARS, DISTANCE_WEIGHTS, GATE, TIER, detectPrereqBlocked, tokenize, jaccardDistance, ncd, recon, v1BlendMetric, distance, bridge, antiTheaterGate, tierOf, and transferScore; no I/O except its direct-run demo.

nodes.label: Transfer Distance Cores (V2 structural metrics)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by transfer-distance.test/proof/bakeoff/v2demo and callers that need scoreTransferV2
nodes.description: Pluggable structural metric bank for the transfer-distance contract: operator-skeleton distance, Brotli NCD, CDM distance, grammar NCD, field classification/distance, mechanism-frame reconstruction, and the shipped V2_CONFIG. Exports FIELD_LEXICONS, FIELD_TO_SYSTEMS, fieldClassify, fieldDistance, operatorSkeletonDistance, brotliNcd, cdmDistance, grammarNcd, mechanismFrameDistance, CANDIDATES, V2_CONFIG, and scoreTransferV2.

nodes.label: YURI Jaccard (hot-tier saturation probe)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by corpus-match, corpus-match.collapse, kagami-memory-consolidator deterministicDedup, and tests; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Embedding-free token set/frequency similarity primitive plus Hopfield-inspired hot-memory saturation detector. Exports tokenize, tokenFreq, jaccard, tfCosine, and saturationProbe; caps tokenization input size, reports deterministic mergePairs/load/overCapacity, and supplies the similarity core used by corpus matching and memory dedup.

nodes.label: YURI MDL (marginal-bits redundancy axis)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by memory-relocator planRelocations and yuri-mdl tests; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Pure gzip-based Minimum Description Length redundancy primitive for memory demotion decisions. Exports DEFAULT_QUALITY_FLOOR_CHARS, marginalBits, and redundancyVerdict; computes normalized marginal description length of a body given the rest of the store, treats short/blank bodies as low-quality, and only supplies a protect-or-redundant axis for upstream AND-gated relocation.

nodes.label: YURI MinHash + LSH (deterministic set similarity accelerator)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by corpus-match LSH path, corpus-match tests, and yuri-minhash tests; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Deterministic MinHash and locality-sensitive hashing primitive for approximate Jaccard candidate generation. Exports fnv1a, makeHashes, minhashSignature, estimateJaccard, lshBands, and tuneBands; uses fixed-seed LCG permutation parameters, FNV-1a token hashing, overflow-safe modular affine hashing, all-MAX empty signatures, and deterministic band tuning.

nodes.label: YURI Phi (π/φ/Fibonacci applied primitives)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by yuri-phi tests and future math/circuitry consumers; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Pure deterministic π, golden-ratio, golden-angle, and Fibonacci primitive set for 1-D minimization, discrete threshold search, anti-resonant cadence, and even 2-D/angular placement. Exports PHI, INV_PHI, INV_PHI_SQ, GOLDEN_ANGLE, fib, fibBig, fibSequence, goldenSectionSearch, fibonacciSearchMin, phiPoint, phiSequence, goldenAnglePoint, and goldenAnglePoints.

nodes.label: YURI Token Expand (embedding-free semantic feature bridge)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by corpus-match.collapse, circuitry-auto-register, self-improvement cross-reference similarity, and tests; CLI self-demo when run directly
nodes.description: Deterministic feature-expansion layer that repairs tokenization collapse without embeddings. Exports charShingles, tokenCharSim, buildCooccurrence, ppmi, buildExpansionMap, buildPpmiProfiles, sparseCosine, buildSecondOrderMap, expandTokenSet, weightedJaccard, features, makeFeatureFn, and plainFeatureFn; builds tok/c4/sem/sem2 feature sets from char shingles, PPMI co-occurrence, and optional second-order PPMI-profile cosine while preserving prefix-filter completeness.

nodes.label: Self-Improvement Cross-Reference (taxonomy + similarity index)
nodes.triggeredBy: import by weekly-comp consolidateWeek and cross-reference tests
nodes.description: Lesson cross-reference engine for the self-improvement extract surface: owns the canonical failure taxonomy, alias normalization, markdown lesson walking/parsing, tag classification, cross-domain bridge buckets, complete prefix-filter similarity relations, and markdown rendering for cross-reference and prevention rules. Exports TAXONOMY, CANONICAL_TAGS, normalizeToken, walkMarkdownFiles, deriveLessonDomain, parseLessonMetadata, resolveCanonicalTag, dedupeTags, classifyLesson, buildCrossReferenceIndex, buildSimilarityCrossReference, renderCrossReferenceMarkdown, renderPreventionRulesMarkdown, extractLessonQuestions, extractLessonTitle, and summarizeLesson.

nodes.label: Weekly Comp (self-improvement consolidation writer)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI `node _SYSTEM/Scripts/self-improvement/weekly-comp.mjs`; import by weekly-consolidation, cross-reference tests, and yuri-lifecycle-controller promotion_path reference
nodes.description: Weekly self-improvement consolidation CLI/library: collects lessons from 02_EXTRACT entries and experiments, builds the cross-reference index, renders a weekly digest, prevention rules, markdown index, and JSON index, then archives raw lessons unless dry-run is set. Exports root/path constants, isoWeek, pickRoot, pickWeek, pickDryRun, collectLessons, consolidateWeek, renderWeeklyDigest, and main.

nodes.label: Weekly Consolidation (weekly-comp CLI alias)
nodes.triggeredBy: CLI `node _SYSTEM/Scripts/self-improvement/weekly-consolidation.mjs`; import as a compatibility re-export of weekly-comp
nodes.description: Thin compatibility entrypoint for the weekly self-improvement consolidator. It imports main from weekly-comp, runs it when invoked directly, and re-exports the full weekly-comp surface so older callers can use the weekly-consolidation module without duplicating consolidation logic.

reads the externalized knob file and fail-closed-validates it (dropping non-finite values) before returning the merged config object.
references the gate's verdict/label shape to validate and structure each trace record against the canonical schema.
appends one Privacy-Gate-validated JSONL gate-evaluation record per gated transition to the day's trace file.

resolves the current user handle to attribute the legacy dispatch trace record.

runs each labelled scenario through gateProposal to score the gate's falseAccept / falseReject rate.

pushes scenario modules through computeU/computeDeltaU/gateProposal to produce the experiment's ΔU descent results.
calls traceGateEvaluation so every experiment transition is recorded through the same Privacy-Gate-validated trace path as live ticks.
writes the per-run experiment result JSON plus the appended energy-trace JSONL records for the scenario.
references the gate semantics to compute the derived metrics the read-only dashboard renders.
pulls the legacy dispatch-trace data so the dashboard can show the retired-path provenance alongside live ticks.
reads the accumulated trace JSONL history to build the dashboard's real-data object (tagged real/simulated/planned).
previews 3 scenarios through the real gateProposal so the cockpit shows the actual effect of a proposed dial change before applying it.
uses the config loader to validate proposed dials fail-closed against DEFAULT_WEIGHTS before any write.
calls the FSRS scorer to preview how retention dials behave under the proposed tuning.
is the ONLY writer of the knob surface — DEV-gated POST /apply persists the validated tuned dials to the weights file.
appends a changelog record for every applied dial change so weight edits are auditable.
references the tick core to confirm the live ΔU path is importable and operational as part of the liveness probe.
reads the hooks config to confirm the energy-tick PostToolUse hook is actually registered.
checks the trace directory for accruing records (reporting absence rather than failing) as the heartbeat signal.
runs the real gateProposal in enforce semantics over labelled transitions to produce the confusion-matrix teeth-proof.
replays recorded trace records to measure the real-traffic false-positive rate that gates graduation to enforcement.
imports DEFAULT_WEIGHTS as the in-code baseline the config file is asserted to match value-for-value.
loads the validated config so it can compare each loaded value against the in-code default.
exercises the tick core's config consumption to confirm the defaults invariant holds along the live path.
checks the FSRS knob block against its in-code defaults so retention tuning can't silently drift.
reads the config file to assert every externalized value equals the in-code default (the _doc.values_are_defaults invariant).
Writes the validated Track-B memory file (v3 frontmatter, memory/-root containment enforced) when the mediated add/remove/edit path is used instead of a native direct Write.
Rebuilds the dense [HANDLE](file) MEMORY.md index via updateIndex() so even direct-Write (wrapper-less) memories self-heal into the boot index on reindex.
Invokes queryCold to over-fetch BM25 cue-matched cold rows (topK×4 for re-rank headroom) as the candidate pool for associative retrieval.
Calls recordUse on every surfaced recall (testing-effect reactivation) and buildUsageIndex to fold useCount/recency into the recall blend.
Loads the recall block from energy-weights.json to get the recency/salience/crosslink blend knobs that weight the top-K ranking.
Reads the cold FTS5 store to source recall candidates; currently returns nothing because the DB holds 0 rows until demotion executes.
Appends a recall event to the usage ledger so each surfaced memory reinforces its use-signal for the relocator's retrievability scoring.
Writes the bounded top-K candidate envelope (atomic tmp+rename) for the NEXT turn to consume — the one-turn-lag handoff to the prompt context.
Upserts demoted memory bodies + metadata (salience/base-stability/crosslinks/demotedAt) into the embedding-free cold FTS5 DB via better-sqlite3.
Appends best-effort recall/reinforce records to the replayable use-signal ledger that replaces the broken atime-LRU signal.
Calls evaluateRetention to compute FSRS retrievability R(t) per memory and decide which fall below the demotion floor.
Reads buildUsageIndex (useCount/lastUsed/lastReinforced) as the real use-signal feeding the FSRS effective-stability boost — not mtime/atime.
Upserts the verbatim body of each demoted memory into the cold store so forgetting is relocation, not deletion.
Imports memoryRoot to resolve the Track-B memory/ directory it scans and relocates files out of.
Writes the demoted memory (via the cold store's upsert) into the cold FTS5 DB as the durable destination of a forget.
Moves the source .md file into the reversible relocated/ dir (double-safety alongside the cold-store copy) so nothing is ever deleted.
Records a tombstone for each relocated slug so the active index knows it was demoted and promoteHot() can restore it byte-identical.
Calls runSubconsciousPass (FSRS demote-plan + executeRelocation) as the consolidation half of the daily subconscious pass.
Reads cold slugs (get) to build cold re-promotion proposals for memories under renewed recall pressure.
Reads the usage index to find cold slugs with recall pressure (useCount≥3) that qualify as re-promotion candidates.
Routes each cold re-promotion candidate into an operator-gated Track-A proposal via the kernel's propose pipeline rather than auto-promoting.
Loads the fsrs/recall knobs from energy-weights.json that parameterize the demotion scoring and re-promotion thresholds.
Writes the Qwen3.5-4B MLX review verdict (stale/dup/contradiction findings) across Track-B files as the daily memory-health report.
Reads the cold store to assess which demoted memories have accrued enough recall pressure to propose re-promotion.
Calls appendKagamiEvent on memory promotion so the canonical-memory mutation is broadcast onto the system event bus.
Uses lane-kernel's protected-surface checks (isProtectedPath/safeRuntimePath) and RBAC-by-lane authority to gate proposals and writes.
Calls requiredEvidenceIdsForTask to map a proposal's task string to the required evidence-source IDs before promotion.
Appends the promoted canonical entry to the durable Track-A ledger (the third leg of the propose→decide→ledger dual-ledger).
Appends each proposeMemoryWrite as a pending Track-A proposal awaiting an operator/autopilot decision.
Reads the warm canonical store (incl. MEMORY.md index) to source recallEntries/recallMemory results over Track-A operating truth.
Records each keep/rewrite/reject/defer verdict back through the kernel's recordMemoryProposalDecision so the dual-ledger stays authoritative.
Uses lane-kernel to resolve lane authority and protected-surface rules when deterministically reviewing a proposal's mutation intent.
Spawns secret-leak-scan before any scoped commit so a detected secret aborts the commit (non-zero exit).
Appends the autopilot's review decision per proposal as the decisions leg of the Track-A audit trail.
Optionally stages ONLY the source/docs allowlist and commits, refusing if allowlist paths were dirty pre-run (scoped, never broad git add).
Reads the staged diff to scan for secret patterns before the autopilot is allowed to finalize a scoped commit.
Writes the STM/MTM/LTM lifecycle transitions, importance scores, and consolidation/quarantine results into the large legacy SQLite memory.db.
Spawns memory_governor.py to persist the session's episodic observation into memory.db and opportunistically run weekly consolidation.
Reads the last sentinel learning-session observation as the episodic content to capture at SessionEnd.
Writes the episodic Track-A memory into memory.db (via the governor) as the durable SessionEnd capture.
Moves atime-stale memory/patterns/*.md files into patterns-archive/ via the legacy atime-LRU evict path — DORMANT, no live trigger fires this.
opens the FTS5/BM25 corpus index read-only to run the quoted-term MATCH query and return path+snippet results ranked by bm25

writes the synthesized, provenance-tagged research findings as a dated markdown file that joins the searchable corpus only after a subsequent manual ai reindex
routes 'ai search' / 'ai find' to the corpus search engine (exec-style, replacing the process) as the layer's front-door query path
routes 'ai reindex' / 'ai search-index [--full]' to the corpus indexer to manually build or refresh search-index.db
Calls resolveRole to determine whether the session is dev or coworker, since coworker-role triggers the push/remote/role-path mutation denials.
Reads the credential file's existence to fail-closed into a role decision (no/broken creds collapses to coworker), and reads /tmp session packet for tier.
Appends an audit record on every deny so blocked Bash attempts are durably logged.
Calls resolveRole to decide whether to deny the coworker-role write onto the protected guard/role/credential trust surface.
Reads the credential to resolve role, then realpath-resolves the on-disk write target for symlink-safe canonical ancestor-climb matching.
Appends an audit record when a coworker-role write onto the trust surface is denied.
Reads the scrypt-hashed credential to verify the YURI_DEV_KEY passphrase via timingSafeEqual; a broken read with creds present is treated as tampering and fails closed to coworker.
Calls into the session-state mediator to read the plan_dispatch_gate and write back gate.satisfied / incremented warn_count after evaluating the control-plane packet.
Imports the canonical CONTROL_FILE_PREFIXES list from lane-kernel so the control-file set is single-sourced rather than re-declared in the guard.
Writes gate state — sets plan_dispatch_gate.satisfied and increments warn_count — so the routing verdict persists across turns.
imports FSRS-4.5 retrievability scoring to FSRS-order the Track-B MEMORY.md rows when they overflow the 12-row working-memory cap, so the most-retrievable memories survive into the boot brain block.

reads the 9 persona-rule headings out of SOUL.md to materialize the persona contract injected into the subagent's startup context.

writes its last-run record to neuron-loop.log on each launchd-driven pass, so brain-inject can read it back into the NEURON_LOOP boot section next session (the self-improvement loop's only persistence)
appends one validated JSON event line (events.jsonl) per appendKagamiEvent call, recording lifecycle moments such as memory-kernel promotions into the durable cross-organ event spine
queues mined session corrections as learned rules into the global learning ledger (global.md) at Stop, so durable operator corrections become lessons that apply to every agent in every project
prepends a dated newest-first reflection entry (skills used, compact hints, session shape, with a mid-session marker when spawned at tier 4) into the Track-B session-journal.md continuity record
spawns the memory_governor.py health probe (python3 memory_governor.py health) to confirm the Track-A memory.db lifecycle governor is alive as one required liveness check
spawns energy-observability-health.mjs to verify the PostToolUse energy-tick hook is registered and trace records are accruing, surfacing absence rather than failing the energy circuit
reads the persisted lane-health-status snapshot to report current lane/launch health alongside its live probe results
reads only the YAML frontmatter (name + description) of every skill's SKILL.md to build the <startup-index> skills roster — no body parse, no execution.
imports yuri-risk-lite as a module (not as a hook) to run its catastrophe-regex risk scan over scout payloads before dispatching findings.
persists the scout bus — inits/trims it on SessionStart and writes spawned-scout findings on PostToolUse so PreToolUse can later inject them.
calls traceDispatchEvent on the legacy energy-dispatch-bridge (L1165) when the SEAL-team roster runs, emitting one ΔU trace record per dispatch (gated on YURI_ENERGY_OBSERVABILITY=1).

every dispatch calls coreOnDispatch (energy ΔU + memory recall) at start and coreOnResult (evidence + docked-output pulse) on result — the full YURI core fired from INSIDE the lane, the seam any frontier model plugs into.

coreOnDispatch fires traceDispatchEvent on every lane call, recording the invocation into the ΔU/energy landscape (gated on YURI_ENERGY_OBSERVABILITY=1) — a lane call is an input into YURI like a native operator turn, the orchestrating lane just supplies it.
coreOnDispatch calls recall() over the cold store and injects a recall block so the lane carries the same episodic memory a native operator turn gets.
Writes the per-session token-tracking file (plus the weekly rollup) at boot to seed token accounting for the session.
Initializes the canonical session lifecycle file at SessionStart — guarded to skip if an active root session under 4h old already owns it.
Reads context.pct and writes compact_history + context.tier through the session-state mediator to drive the 5-tier /compact ladder.
Reads the memory bus to detect another terminal's recent write and inject a cross-terminal awareness update, and advances the bus cursor.
At compaction tier 4 spawns session-reflect --mid-session detached to capture a reflection before context pressure forces a compact.
Persists compact_history entries and context.tier to the lifecycle file so the next turn's hints and the dashboard see the current compaction state.
Writes tools_used, errors, files_written, and skills_read/written, and arms plan_dispatch_gate on ExitPlanMode, all through the session-state mediator.
On a memory-file write, pushes the changed filename to the bus so concurrent terminals know a memory was just written.
Records the just-completed tool call into the canonical lifecycle file (tool result, error flag, written files, plan-dispatch arm) as the main per-turn bookkeeping write.
Appends this session's memory-write event to the cross-terminal bus cursor file via memory-bus.writeBus.
Spawns token-ledger.mjs write detached, handing off the per-tool estimate for durable crypto-chained, privacy-hashed persistence.
Pushes {tool,estimate,time} and increments estimatedTokens from the per-tool heuristic table, which token-budget-check later reads for the WARN/CRITICAL thresholds.
Appends one tamper-evident event row (prev_hash→event_hash chain, hashed payload/source-path) to the SQLite token_ledger per tool call.
Reads estimatedTokens from the live session file to decide whether to emit the ≥80k WARN or ≥150k CRITICAL budget advisory.
Is the sole mediator that reads and writes the canonical lifecycle file, so every hook routes its session-state mutations through this single fs surface.
Owns the cross-terminal cursor file — writeBus appends a session's recent activity so other terminals can read it.
Reads the current session lifecycle state via the session-state mediator to assemble the periodic snapshot.
Touches the canonical lifecycle file when persisting the ~30-min incremental snapshot of session progress.
Goes through the session-state mediator to read prior counters and stamp aeonic.lastEnforceAt, enforcing its 60s throttle and persisting the compliance check.
Persists the AEONIC enforcement timestamp (aeonic.lastEnforceAt) into the lifecycle session-state file so the next call can honor the 60s throttle window.
Goes through the session-state mediator to write the parsed protocol sections into state.aeonic.sections during SessionStart boot.
Reads the legacy 872-byte MUSUBI_PROTOCOL.md shim (CORE_DIRECTIVES / GLOBAL_LLM_COMPAT_DIRECTIVE / ROLE_MATRIX) to build the <musubi-protocol> boot context block.
Spawns yuri-recall.mjs detached each turn (the hook can't block on it under its <50ms budget) so it runs the query/rank/ledger-bump and writes the recall envelope the NEXT turn consumes.
Consumes the one-turn-lagged subconscious recall envelope written by the prior turn's detached recall (read-then-unlink, consume-once) and re-injects it so a cue surfaces exactly once.
Reads the council-set brain-stale sentinel and, when present, re-injects the volatile brain delta as a <brain-update> block on this turn.
Writes the per-session EOT marker file at SessionStart to arm the continuous-reflection EOT engine for that session id.
